{"problem": "请根据给定规则计算自定义运算值。

【运算规则】
对函数 \(f(x,y),g(x,y)\)，定义
\[
 f■g=\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial g}{\partial x}.
\]

【题目】
给定
\[
 f(x,y)=x^2y+\frac{y}{x},\qquad g(x,y)=\arctan(xy)+y^4.
\]
计算 \(f■g\)。

【作答要求】
使用 LaTeX，并用双中括号包裹最终答案：[[...]]。", "canonical_answer": "[[2xy-\frac{y}{x^2}+\frac{y}{1+x^2y^2}]]", "attempts": [{"panel": 0, "sample": 0, "answer": "[[2xy-\frac{y}{x^2}+\frac{y}{1+x^2y^2}]]", "certificate": "\(\partial f/\partial x=2xy-y/x^2\) and \(\partial g/\partial x=y/(1+x^2y^2)\); adding them gives the stated result (for \(x\ne0\))."}]}

message.content: {"verdict":"valid","reason":"对 f 关于 x 求偏导得到 2xy-y/x^2；对 g 关于 x 求偏导得到 y/(1+x^2y^2)。两者相加正好得到给定标准答案，且定义域要求 x\\ne0 已在证书中说明。","error_types":[],"depth_score":2,"depth_evidence":"需要先分别计算 f 和 g 的 x 偏导，再将两个结果相加，形成两步依赖。","reasoning_type_tags":["deduction","other"],"constraint_type_tags":["equality","other"],"scenario":"abstract","explanation_score":4,"explanation_evidence":"证书明确且可核验地给出两个偏导：\\(\\partial f/\\partial x=2xy-y/x^2\\) 和 \\(\\partial g/\\partial x=y/(1+x^2y^2)\\)，并正确说明将其相加；同时注明 x\\ne0。","solver_correct":[true]}
